title: "Implémentation de la fonction villasenor_gof"
author: "TITO A. Rytrace"

```{r}
villasenor_gof <- function(x, t, a_ref = NULL, dt_eq = NULL) {
  
  if (!require(goft)) {
    install.packages("goft")
    library(goft)
  }
  
  gamma_bridge <- function(t, x, a, dt_eq) {
    
    if(any(diff(t) <= 0)) stop("Les temps doivent être strictement croissants")
    if(a <= 0) stop("a doit être positif")
    
    Np <- floor(max(t) / dt_eq)
    t_eq <- seq(dt_eq, Np * dt_eq, by = dt_eq)
    x_eq <- numeric(Np)
    
    for (i in 1:Np) {
      
      ti <- t_eq[i]
      
      sup_i <- which(t >= ti)[1]
      t_sup <- t[sup_i]
      x_sup <- x[sup_i]
      
      if (sup_i == 1) {
        t_inf <- 0
        x_inf <- 0
      } else {
        t_inf_candidate <- t[sup_i - 1]
        
        if (t_inf_candidate > (i - 1) * dt_eq) {
          t_inf <- t_inf_candidate
          x_inf <- x[sup_i - 1]
        } else {
          t_inf <- (i - 1) * dt_eq
          x_inf <- if (i > 1) x_eq[i - 1] else 0
        }
      }
      
      alpha1 <- a * max(ti - t_inf, 1e-10)
      alpha2 <- a * max(t_sup - ti, 1e-10)
      
      if (alpha1 <= 0 || alpha2 <= 0) {
        stop(paste("Paramètres bêta non positifs:", alpha1, alpha2))
      }
      
      y <- rbeta(1, alpha1, alpha2)
      x_eq[i] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
    }
    
    return(data.frame(time = t_eq, value = x_eq))
  }
  
  tri_sample <- function(dt, dx, dt_eq) {
    
    N <- length(dt)
    
    dt_c <- dt
    dx_c <- dx
    
    dt_s <- numeric(N)
    dx_s <- numeric(N)
    
    max_i <- which.max(dt_c)
    dt_s[1] <- dt_c[max_i]
    dx_s[1] <- dx_c[max_i]
    
    dt_c <- dt_c[-max_i]
    dx_c <- dx_c[-max_i]
    
    for (i in 2:N) {
      
      cum_time <- sum(dt_s[1:(i - 1)])
      diffs <- (cum_time + dt_c) - i * dt_eq
      
      valid <- which(diffs >= 0)
      
      if (length(valid) > 0) {
        choix <- valid[which.min(diffs[valid])]
      } else {
        choix <- which.max(diffs)
      }
      
      dt_s[i] <- dt_c[choix]
      dx_s[i] <- dx_c[choix]
      
      dt_c <- dt_c[-choix]
      dx_c <- dx_c[-choix]
    }
    
    return(list(dt = dt_s, dx = dx_s))
  }
  
  estimer_a <- function(t, x) {
    
    dt <- diff(t)
    dx <- diff(x)
    
    m_hat <- sum(dx) / sum(dt)
    n_hat <- sum((dx - m_hat * dt)^2) /
             (sum(dt) - sum(dt^2) / sum(dt))
    
    return(m_hat^2 / n_hat)
  }
  
  dt <- diff(t)
  dx <- diff(x)
  
  tol <- 1e-8
  if (all(abs(dt - dt[1]) < tol)) {
    resultat <- gamma_test(dx)
  } else {
     if(is.null(dt_eq)) dt_eq <- max(t)/length(dt)
    
    tri <- tri_sample(dt, dx, dt_eq)
    t_tri <- c(0, cumsum(tri$dt))
    x_tri <- c(0, cumsum(tri$dx))
    
    if(is.null(a_ref)) a_ref <- estimer_a(t_tri, x_tri)
    
    interp <- gamma_bridge(t_tri, x_tri, a_ref, dt_eq)
    dx_eq <- diff(c(0, interp$value))
    
    resultat <- gamma_test(dx_eq)
  }
  
  if(resultat$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("p-value =", resultat$p.value, "Rejet H0\n")
  } else {
    cat("p-value =", resultat$p.value, "Non Rejet H0\n")
  }
  
  return(resultat)
}
```


```{r}

# Application 1: Processus Gamma régulier
set.seed(123)
N <- 50
dt_eq <- 1
a_true <- 3
b_true <- 0.5

t_reg <- seq(0, N * dt_eq, by = dt_eq)
x_reg <- numeric(length(t_reg))
for (i in 2:length(t_reg)) {
  x_reg[i] <- x_reg[i-1] + rgamma(1, shape = a_true * dt_eq, rate = b_true)
}

resultat1 <- villasenor_gof(x = x_reg, t = t_reg)
print(resultat1)
```


```{r}

# Application 2: Processus Gamma irrégulier
set.seed(123)
N <- 50
dt_eq <- 1
a_true <- 2
b_true <- 1

t_irr <- sort(runif(N, 0, N * dt_eq))
t_irr <- c(0, t_irr)
x_irr <- numeric(length(t_irr))
for(i in 2:length(t_irr)){
  x_irr[i] <- x_irr[i-1] + rgamma(1, shape = a_true * (t_irr[i]-t_irr[i-1]), rate = b_true)
}

resultat2 <- villasenor_gof(x = x_irr, t = t_irr, dt_eq = 1)
print(resultat2)
```


```{r}
# Application 4: Données réelles Fatigue
library(nlme)
data(Fatigue)
path1 <- subset(Fatigue, Path == 1)
t_real <- path1$cycles * 1e6
x_real <- path1$relLength

resultat4 <- villasenor_gof(x = x_real, t = t_real, dt_eq = 10000)
print(resultat4)

```
